title: Keeping muscles strong
text: Scientists studied the muscles and bones of mice after spaceflight. They looked for ways to protect muscle strength.

title: Lettuce in space
text: NASA grew red lettuce on the space station. Researchers checked whether it was safe to eat.

title: Plants need light
text: Scientists grew mizuna greens on the space station. They studied how different lights affected the crop.

title: Studying radiation
text: Researchers exposed mice to low radiation in a ground experiment. They examined how radiation and simulated low gravity affected the animals.

title: Mice and immune health
text: Scientists studied mouse brains after a stay on the space station. They measured signals linked to inflammation.

title: Light helps seedlings
text: Scientists studied small plants growing in space. They tested how red light changed the plants’ response to weak gravity.
